Hide Menu, Submenu, Report, and Fields for any User, Group Odoo App

Easy to Hide menu, Hide Report, Hide Field, Hide Submenu in Odoo

All in one Hide Menu, Buttons, Actions, Fields, Reports Odoo App helps users to hide any menu, sub menu and report from any user from both user configurations and group configurations. Users also can change fields attributes like make fields invisible or read only. Users can hide/show buttons from the user configuration. Users can hide/show create button, edit button, import button, export action button, export all button, delete action button, duplicate action button, print button and action button using extra user group access rights. You can just activate those hide access for a specific user and that selected button/action option will be hidden for that specific user.

Hide/Invisible Menu

Hide Menu from User Configuration

User can see visible menus.

Under Settings > Users & Companies > Users menu user can "Hide Menu" tab, User have to add menu that he/she wants to hide for particular user.

User can see here selected menus are hidden/invisible for user.

Hide Menu from Group Configuration

User have option to hide menu also from Settings > User & Companies > Groups menu.

On Groups form view user can see "Hide Menu" tab, here user have to select menu items that he/she wants to hide from specific groups, users belongs to this groups also can not see selected menus.

User can see selected menu on groups are hidden/invisible.

Hide/Invisible Submenu

User can hide submenu from both user or groups configuration.

User can see visible submenu for user.

User heve to add submenu that he/she wants to hide by adding "Hide Menu' tab.

User can see selected submenus are hidden/invisible.

Hide/Invisible Report

Hide Report from User Configuration

User can visible report menu for user.

User can hide report menu from group configuration by adding to "Hide Report" tab.

User can see selected menu is hidden

Hide Report from Group Configuration

User can visible report menu for user.

Settings > User & Companies > Groups menu user have to add report menu on "Hide Report" menu.

User can see selected report menu invisible/hidden for group and group users.

Set Readonly OR Invisible any Fields

User can hide or make readonly number of fields, Here user can see marked "GSTIN" is visible fields and "Email" is editable field.

Under models form view user can see "Field Configuration" tab, here user have to add fields and enable "Readonly" and "Invisible" attribute, user also can select groups and this only applies to selected group and groups users.

User can see "GSTIN" field is invisible and "Email" field is readonly.

Hide/Invisible Actions and Buttons

Hide Tickbox from User Configuration

User can tick the tickbox to hide the all button and if you untick the tickbox then it show the all button.

User can see 'Create' button in list view.

Tick on 'Hide Create Button'

User can see 'Create' button hides from the list view.

User can see 'Delete' option in action.

Tick on 'Hide Delete Action' & 'Hide Duplicate Action'

User can see 'Delete' option hides from the action.

User can see 'Export' option in action.

Tick on 'Hide Export Action'

User can see 'Export' action is hides.

User can see 'Import' button in list view.

Tick on 'Hide Import Button'

User can see 'Import' button hides from the list view.

User can see 'Action', 'Edit' and 'Print' button.

Tick on 'Hide Action Button', 'Hide Edit Button' & 'Hide Print Button'

User can see 'Action', 'Edit' and 'Print' button hides.
